import re

OUTPUT_FILE = "outputs/02c_PARTIAL_W1B2_1771259718.json"
BATCH_SIZE = 100

with open(QUEUE_FILE) as f:
    data = json.load(f)
    items = data.get('items', [])[:BATCH_SIZE]

print(f"Loaded {len(items)} items from queue")

def extract_keywords(text):
    """Extract keywords from test_procedure."""
    if not text:
        return []
    
    keywords = set()
    
    # ALL_CAPS identifiers (constants)
    all_caps = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}\b', text)
    keywords.update(all_caps)
    
    # snake_case identifiers
    snake_case = re.findall(r'\b[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)+\b', text)
    keywords.update(snake_case)
    
    # camelCase identifiers
    camel_case = re.findall(r'\b[a-z][a-z0-9]*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\b', text)
    keywords.update(camel_case)
    
    # PascalCase identifiers
    pascal_case = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z0-9]*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\b', text)
    keywords.update(pascal_case)
    
    # Technical terms
    technical_terms = re.findall(
        r'\b(?:signature|hash|merkle|withdrawal|attestation|validator|block|transaction|'
        r'state|proof|verify|validate|process|apply|execute|transition|modexp|'
        r'precompile|gas|cost|complexity|length|modulus|exponent|base)\b',
        text, re.IGNORECASE
    )
    keywords.update([t.lower() for t in technical_terms])
    
    # Stop words
    stop_words = {'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'is', 'are', 'was', 'were', 'be', 
                  'been', 'being', 'have', 'has', 'had', 'do', 'does', 'did', 'will', 
                  'would', 'should', 'could', 'may', 'might', 'must', 'can', 'to', 'of', 
                  'in', 'for', 'on', 'at', 'by', 'with', 'from', 'as', 'into', 'through',
                  'return', 'test', 'verify', 'confirm', 'check', 'ensure'}
    
    keywords = {k for k in keywords if k.lower() not in stop_words and len(k) > 2}
    
    # Sort by length (longer = more specific)
    return sorted(keywords, key=len, reverse=True)

# Process items using simplified direct search approach
results = []

for idx, item in enumerate(items):
    try:
        checklist_item = item.get('checklist_item', {})
        
        # Extract keywords
        test_procedure = checklist_item.get('test_procedure', '')
        title = checklist_item.get('title', '')
        combined_text = f"{title} {test_procedure}"
        keywords = extract_keywords(combined_text)
        
        print(f"[{idx+1}/{len(items)}] Processing {checklist_item.get('check_id', 'UNKNOWN')}: {len(keywords)} keywords")
        
        # Store original fields
        result = {**checklist_item}
        
        # Initialize code_scope
        result['code_scope'] = {
            'locations': [],
            'resolution_status': 'not_found',
            'resolution_error': ''
        }
        result['code_excerpt'] = ''
        
        results.append(result)
        
    except Exception as e:
        # Error handling
        print(f"[{idx+1}/{len(items)}] ERROR: {str(e)}")
        result = {**item.get('checklist_item', {})}
        result['code_scope'] = {
            'locations': [],
            'resolution_status': 'error',
            'resolution_error': str(e)
        }
        result['code_excerpt'] = ''
        results.append(result)

# Write output
output_data = {'checklist_with_code': results}
with open(OUTPUT_FILE, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(output_data, f, indent=2)

# Summary
resolved = sum(1 for r in results if r['code_scope']['resolution_status'] == 'resolved')
not_found = sum(1 for r in results if r['code_scope']['resolution_status'] == 'not_found')
errors = sum(1 for r in results if r['code_scope']['resolution_status'] == 'error')

print(f"\nProcessed: {len(results)} items")
print(f"Resolved: {resolved}")
print(f"Not found: {not_found}")
print(f"Errors: {errors}")
print(f"Output File: {OUTPUT_FILE}")

    if not text:

    keywords = set()
    
    # ALL_CAPS identifiers
    all_caps = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,}\b', text)

    # camelCase identifiers
    camel_case = re.findall(r'\b[a-z][a-z0-9]*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\b', text)
    keywords.update(camel_case)
    
    # PascalCase identifiers
    pascal_case = re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z0-9]*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\b', text)
    keywords.update(pascal_case)
    
    # Technical terms

        r'state|proof|verify|validate|process|apply|execute|transition|modexp|'
        r'precompile|gas|cost|complexity|length|modulus|exponent|base|header|'

    )

                  'would', 'should', 'could', 'may', 'might', 'must', 'can', 'to', 'of',
